title: Boba Fett's Rancor
subtitle: Creature
description: After assuming the role of daimyo of Mos Espa, effectively replacing Jabba the Hutt, Boba Fett finds himself on the wrong side of the Hutt's two squabbling cousins. The Twins, as they are called, failed in assassinating Fett, so instead apologized by gifting him a young rancor. Fett bonded with the creature, eventually riding the beast into battle.
